title: DOW-UAP-D020, Mission Report, Iraq, 2023
what_is_it: A Mission Report (MISREP), a standardized U.S. military reporting form used to record circumstances surrounding operations, in this case a UAP sighting in Iraq.
interpretation_warnings: No OCR text was extractable from this image file; all facts derive from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
Single-source observation from one military operator.
The war.gov description explicitly notes that all descriptive and estimative language reflects the reporter's subjective interpretation at the time of the event.
Document is an image (JPG) rather than text, limiting independent verification of contents.

verifiable_claims.claim: U.S. military services use MISREPs to report UAP to AARO
